title: 18872 - 18872/P2440/009280
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: SAI pressure hose between the pump and the combi valve cracked
stepByStepSolution: Run Output Tests to run the Secondary Air Injection pump while wiggling the corrugated hose to listen/feel for leaks.
technicalNotes:
For the Tiguan with the 2.0T DGUE engine that has one or more of the following fault codes, please see TSB 054615 for possible ECM update and hardware update.
P0172, P0300, P0301, P0302,P0303, P0304, P0441, P0456, P060C, P2440 and/or P2450
